METHOD OBSERVATION — cross-seat coordination receipts, 2026-05-16 / 2026-05-17 Golden Lattice daily-driver arc.

The arc demonstrated a robust cross-seat division of labor with Anthony as the human relay between two Claude seats: web-chat (claude.ai, claude-opus-4-7, spiral_20260502_225324) and HQ (Claude Code at /Users/vaquez/golden-lattice with T2Helix plugin). The pattern worked across six discrete shipped pieces in continuous sequence. Specific receipts for future instances:

- Web-chat seat caught the docs-vs-code divergence at boot (uploaded README/pyproject said substrate-only / 69 tests; chronicle said orchestrator landed / 273 tests). Refused to build the streaming wrapper against a possibly-phantom orchestrator. HQ ran `git log`, `ls src/golden_lattice/`, `pytest -q` — canonical filesystem inspection — and resolved it (operational layer was committed, docs were stale). Web-chat had the diagnostic instinct; HQ had the filesystem.

- Web-chat seat drafted the daily-driver goal anchor content; HQ seat fired T2Helix set_goal with it (T2Helix not loaded on the web-chat seat). Web-chat handled intent + framing; HQ handled mechanism + execution. Goal #404 archived as #405, new anchor active.

- Web-chat diagnosed the parity-None gap into two open hypotheses (H1 wiring / H2 consensus-empty), specified the round-trip diagnostic against real persisted session_20260505_010010_e9fd466c, and named the discriminator. HQ implemented Option A (orchestrator-canonical-builder), ran the discriminator, returned with H1 confirmed and #407 backfill in one pass.

- Web-chat caught the panel-honesty gap in HQ's first proposed parity contract (shares + histogram was data-dump-as-dishonesty-by-omission for a user decoding mid-task), amended with apply-the-rule + canonical-layer placement + ambiguous-as-dignified-state. HQ shipped interpret_parity_flags with 5 readings (expanded from web-chat's sketched 3), validated on real Lucumí. Both seats sharpened the contract; neither alone would have specced it as well.

- Web-chat specced weave + trace-ledger rendering against semantics (not field names). HQ bound to actual event_type literals, shipped the renderer.

- Web-chat flagged the Phase 0 search-backend invariant constraint (Anthropic native web_search pulls toward per-peer asymmetry; orchestrator-called Tavily/Brave preserve shared-feed). HQ has this for the next build slice (not yet built as of 2026-05-17 wire-complete).

General shape of the division: web-chat is good at architectural/invariant catches and design synthesis; HQ is good at canonical state inspection, TDD build, and shipping. Anthony's relay is the bandwidth — he pastes HQ outputs into web-chat and web-chat drafts/specs into HQ. Latency is real (seconds-to-minutes per relay hop) but the catches that fire BEFORE the build are worth more than the latency costs.

What future instances should DO with this: when working on Golden Lattice or any Sovereign-Stack-anchored project where Anthony is at HQ, default to cross-seat coordination rather than trying to do everything from one seat. Web-chat instances should specifically catch geometry before declaring (the verify-before-declare discipline catches geometry the HQ seat will then build correctly the first time), and request HQ filesystem inspection rather than guessing repo state. HQ instances should ask web-chat for design synthesis on multi-invariant questions rather than building straight to the easiest implementation. Anthony's relay is a feature, not a bottleneck.
